recentItems.title: అంగారకుడి చందమామల పుట్టుక వెనుక అసలు రహస్యం ఏంటి? | జపాన్ MMX మిషన్ విశేషాలు
recentItems.description:
Japan's space agency, JAXA, is preparing for an ambitious mission to uncover the mysteries of Mars' two moons, Phobos and Deimos. The Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission aims to study Phobos, collect surface samples and bring them back to Earth for detailed scientific analysis. By investigating these mysterious moons, scientists hope to discover how they formed and gain new insights into the history of Mars and the early Solar System. Watch this video to explore the objectives, technology and significance of Japan's groundbreaking MMX mission.
